notes.title: Version 0.4 - released! Lots of new music + visual updates + bugfixes + etc
Version 0.33 - released! Large VFX/UX/UI update + 2 new dungeons + bugfixes etc
notes.content:
[h1]Hello adventurers![/h1]

Sorry for long radio silence, but I had to pause the project and postpone releases for a little bit, because of personal problems.

This is one of the biggest updates for the game so far, which is why we jumped ahead a few versions (0.27->0.33).
It will be last major update before full release - however we will still release bugfixes in the meantime.

We plan to exit EA and fully release the game somewhere this year - along with the final dungeon, final boss, some new content and some in-game story (if time will allow).

If any of you who will read this likes the game and would like to see more - please help us reach people who could enjoy the game :)

Now without further ado, here is the changelog:

[h2]Changelog 0.33:[/h2]
[h3]Mechanics:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Grimoire presets - now you can have many grimoire presets - so you no longer have to re-do your grimoire each time in order to min-max - just load a preset or create new one!
[*] Sanity mechanic - each card costs 1 sanity, sanity regenerates 1 per turn. No more infinite combo cheesing (you can still cheese, but its a diet cheese ;) ).
[*] Added very slight bias towards enemies spawning in groups, rather than completely randomly.
[*] Enemies revealed by enemy abilities, and not by the player, will not attack the player right away.
[/list]

[h3]UX:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Many new VFXs - for cards, units, tiles and more!
[*] Dungeon goal & effect - now can be seen during the run!
[*] Enemies which have dodge/immunity show “DODGED!” or “IMMUNE!” when they are damaged.
[*] Hovering over card name in game log now shows up this card.
[*] Fixed some enemies descriptions.
[*] Karma store no longer shows up if you have 0 karma.
[*] Added a warning when picking a card that costs more than your max of given resource.
[*] Added tooltips for each resource cost on card (colorblind people will have an easier time playing now!).
[*] Added tooltips with each keyword description.
[*] On death effect descriptions are combined.
[*] Used up one-time abilities of enemies are no longer displayed.
[*] Tutorial improvements / new steps.
[*] Edge scrolling improvements.
[*] Karma shop improvements.
[*] Tooltips improvements.
[*] Settings improvements.
[*] Summary window improvements.
[*] Unit descriptions now fit the area better.
[*] Grimoire filters improvements.
[*] Added filtering by cards rarity.
[*] Added a new search bar in grimoire.
[*] Changed labyrinth objective from “unlock the exit”, to just “escape labyrinth”.
[*] You can now pick up the 'Crown' in the 'Tiny Treasure Room' even on an empty level.
[*] Added hiding enemies on the mouse scroll button.
[/list]

[h3]UI:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] New character portraits
[*] New event window
[*] Further implementation of a new font.
[*] Small improvements to deck and discard windows.
[*] Other small improvements
[/olist]

[h3]Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Two new dungeons: “Omega World” and “Devil’s Mound”.
[*] Two new items: “Potion of Invisibility” and “Potion of Sanity”.
[*] Two new cards: “Madman's Might” and “Purple Pill”
[/list]

[h3]Optimization:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed frame drops in character creation and in game, that were generated by loading new cards. Now all the objects are properly cached.
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed assassin unlock to “while invisible, kill an elite enemy with penetrating damage card”.
[*] Changed "On Discover" effects can now be triggered only once; hiding and revealing them again won't trigger this effect.
[/list]

[h3]Buffs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the “After x turn” effect from resource cards like “Fast Breathing”.
[*] “Victorious Strike” now restores at least 1 stamina.
[/list]

[h3]Nerfs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] “Berserking” no longer adds its health cost, to its damage.
[*] "Armor Swap" now only drains as much enemy armor as you can restore, rather than draining all enemy armor.
[/list]

[h3]VFX: [/h3]
[list]
[*] New Spell cards visual effect.
[*] New Unholy cards visual effect.
[*] New Music cards visual effect.
[*] New Fire cards visual effect.
[*] New Attack cards visual effect.
[*] New unit death animation + visual effect.
[*] New tile revealing visual effect.
[/list]

[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improvements to Polish translation.
[*] Set correct tags for ‘Bomb’, ‘ Poison Bomb’, ‘Poison Dart’, “Poison Nova”. 
[/list]


[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed icon display on desktop.
[*] Fixed “buy on steam” button in demo, which displayed a wrong string.
[*] Fixed 4:3 aspect ratio.
[*] Fixed grimoire filter-related problems.
[*] Fixed unit description position relative to unit position.
[*] Fixed buttons in character creation/karma shop.
[*] Fixed Time Bender revealing himself.
[*] Fixed problems with card dissolving animation.
[*] Fixed problems with UI when changing aspect ratio.
[*] Fixed problems with Discord class.
[*] Fixed problems with Mage class unlock.
[*] Fixed problems with Fairy class unlock.
[*] Fixed problems with class unlock descriptions in the summary window.
[*] Fixed problems with cards blessing mechanics.
[*] Fixed problems with Karma store tooltips.
[*] Fixed problems with “Mimic” mechanic.
[*] Fixed progress reset when using more than 1 instance of Gluttony.
[*] Fixed an edge case which could freeze the drawing of cards.
[*] Scrollbar handle is no longer stretched.
[*] The game now updates changes made to your cards by passive abilities right at the start of the game, rather than after the first turn.
[*] Fixed problem with translating objectives: you no longer need to reset the game.
[*] Fixed problem with on-going timers on cards to work correctly on continued saves.
[*] Fixed problem with enemy effects with timers; now they are counting correctly.
[*] Fixed problem with refreshing of “for turns x” cards descriptions in discard.
[*] Fixed problem with cards ability timer for counting “Echoing Strike” cards as a part of combo.
[*] Cards with “After x turns” effects no longer respond to your mana/stamina pools while their effect is active.
[*] Fixed problem with cards not counting magic and strength in statistics, while in blessed window.
[*] Fixed problem with quest log memory, you will no longer lose progress on 'portal fragments' upon continuing the game.
[*] Fixed problem with golem HP doubling on every re-entering of the current save.
[*] Fixed problem with hands slots blocking upon re-entering to the current save.
[*] Fixed problem with displaying 999+ cards in deck and discard upon re-entering to the current save.
[*] Fixed problem with game crash appearing, after continuing your save.
[*] Fixed problem with two different cards occupying a single slot.
[*] Card slots no longer appear on top of each other, while using the “Aquarius” constellation.
[*] Fixed problem with “Kick” card direction arrow, not disappearing after using the card.
[*] Fixed problem with game crashing when rapidly changing between character portraits.
[*] Fixed problem with game crash that occurred when leaving the game while still drawing cards.
[*] Fixed problem with the “Deck” tutorial step.
[*] Fixed problem with loot bag, where you were not able to leave the window, after selecting the card.
[*] Fixed the problem with the refreshing of game object statuses.
[*] Librarian will no longer be triggering bug, where his too expensive cards were displayed as playable.
[*] Fixed problem with In-game log not disappearing after time.
[*] “Goblin Leader” now works properly in the “Wandering Lands”.
[*] Fixed problem with banish mechanic; it will no longer make some units invisible.
[*] Fixed problem with “Imp” on-death effect not passing when hidden.
[*] Fixed problem with the issue where units eaten by the "Devourer" were not being removed while the player was on another level.
[*] AoE cards will now only inflict damage on units that are currently on the board.
[*] “Larva Egg” will no longer reveal all surrounding tiles on death.
[*] All Steam achievements are now functioning correctly on Windows.
[*] Fixed problem with game starting by default in 960p.
[*] Fixed issues with updating the language change while in-game.
[*] Fixed problem with character class window.
[*] Fixed problem with the Volcano dungeon not ending when you killed all enemies.
[*] Fixed problem of the player getting stuck in the arena.
[*] “Hex” card now counts all your curses correctly.
[/list]

[h3]Known issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Achievements do not work via proton on Linux.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.27 - released! Achievements + Cloud + UX overhaul + two new dungeons.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurers![/h1]

In this update we added achievements, steam cloud support, UX/UI overhaul, bugfixes and... new dungeons!
Have fun in Infestation and Infernia - happy dying!

Bestiary-related achievements are temporarily disabled and un-achievable, but this will be fixed next week!

[h2]Changelog 0.27:[/h2]
[h3]UI/UX:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added unit effect icons.
[*] Added keywords explanation for cards “details”.
[*] Added quality-based item frames.
[*] Added type-based frames to monsters.
[*] Added dungeon goal display.
[*] No “floating” zoom now - it follows mouse scroll instantly now.
[*] All tooltips have limited width and are multiline now.
[*] Unit details appear on hover (right click works too).
[*] Armor degen no longer shows if enemy has no armor.
[*] Perks now show the related card on hover.
[*] Now you can always see how many races/classes are in the game.
[*] Now you can see which cards you gained/lost/blessed during events.
[*] New unit details window.
[*] New unlock popup.
[*] New campfire & altar of sacrifice UI.
[*] New summary.
[*] New game log.
[*] New deck/discard view.
[*] New dungeon view.
[*] New damage icon.
[*] New sealed handslot sprite.
[*] New edge scrolling (can be disabled in options).
[*] Tutorial improvements.
[*] Few descriptions/tooltips improvements.
[*] Shop improvements.
[*] Bestiary improvements.
[*] Loading animation in-between scenes should be smoother now.
[/list]

[h3]Mechanics:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added “first win bonus” for each dungeon - gain 10x normal karma reward for completing the dungeon for the first time.
[*] Hold down ALT/middle mouse button or use the button on the UI, to see what is under monsters.
[/list]

[h3]Steam integrations:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added achievements.
[*] Added cloud save support.
[/list]

[h3]Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added “Infestation” dungeon.
[*] Added “Infernia” dungeon.
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Karma shop rebalanced, now all upgrades have their respective max level.

[b]Buffs:[/b]
[*] Touch of Midas:
- Gain 10 gold -> Gain 79 gold (atomic number of gold!).

[*] Masterful Attack:
- Stamina cost 7->4.

[*] Masterful Spell:
- Mana cost 7->4.

[b]Nerfs:[/b]
[*] Paladin’s “Wrath of the Heavens” perk:
- Adds 2 radius to Holy Smite instead of infinity.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed random card destroy RNG (now it is true random).
[*] Fixed blurry texts.
[*] Fixed card hover shader - it is no longer too bright.
[*] Fixed buttons highlighting.
[*] Fixed Time Lab summary text.
[*] Fixed Fire Imp ability.
[*] Fixed few minor tutorial bugs.
[*] Fixed Grimoire crashes.
[*] Fixed Golden Lands effect.
[*] Fixed Guard unit ability.
[*] Fixed Moonwalker unlock.
[*] Cards burn animation length is constant now.
[*] Added missing translations.
[*] Original boss tile no longer reveals surroundings if boss isn’t there.
[*] Mouse hover no longer goes through interface.
[*] Same unlock does not display more than one time now.
[*] Master volume no longer overrides Music with “streaming mode” enabled.
[*] Wisdom points are now properly updated.
[*] AoE debuff against Slimes no longer counts as one attack towards unlocks such as Sculptor.
[*] Cards now properly calculate damage when buffed.
[*] Loading an empty save no longer causes a crash.
[*] Killing an elite during a tutorial no longer causes the game to go into frozen state.
[*] Resetting a tutorial and then continuing the game no longer causes the tutorial to be unfinishable.
[*] You can no longer use campfire after death.
[*] Card rarity popup is now closer to the origin.
[*] Card in discard destroy animation no longer appears on deck instead of discard.
[*] Not pushing an enemy no longer causes a popup to display.
[*] Using “weapon blessing” with stamina card no longer can trigger mage unlock.
[*] Silence now properly stops passive immunities (e.g: Rocky).
[*] Unlocking something while in store no longer causes a visual bug.
[*] Sell tag in shop no longer gets red color.
[*] Only existing “fire” cards counts towards Volcano unlock.
[*] Transparent objects on the interface no longer can block clicking a tile.
[*] Blessed card can no longer be removed during blessing.
[*] Echoing Strike can no longer unlock Assassin.
[*] Monsters abilities no longer duplicate (e.g: Volcano, 2x fire immunity).
[*] Continuing in Plaguegeon no longer zeroes player’s resources.
[*] Continuing a game no longer can change “next unlocks” display.
[*] Continuing in Caverns no longer causes an additional stairs to appear.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.26 - released! Two new dungeons.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurers![/h1]

In this update we focused mainly on polishing the game, to the point that we even added polish language support!
(pun intended)
Two new dungeons for you to try out - Volcano and Time Lab - both are pretty hard.

We rebalanced some cards to ensure there will be no easy "infinity combo" scenarios.

Currently we are working on automatic AI-powered localization feature, which will enable us to translate the game to lots of different languages.
We do it because of two reasons: it's cheaper & working with AI is fun!
So, this first version of the translation is a prototype - we will make it better in next versions!

We could translate the game to polish language by ourselves without much of an issue, but since this is our native language, it is easier for us to spot where AI made a mistake, so we can reiterate on the approach. Once polish language is translated to the point we are happy with, it should work for other languages too, by leveraging the ability of LLM.

[h2]Changelog 0.26:[/h2]
[h3]UX:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Edge scrolling temporarily disabled (will be reintroduced in 0.27 once we make it work better, with an option to turn it off).
[*] Longer card burn animation, to ensure everyone are able to read the card before it is burnt.
[*] Added tooltips for Bestiary and Grimoire buttons in character creation.
[*]  Added “play in background” option (can be disabled in settings).
[*] Deck & discard are now viewable when selecting items/cards.
[*] “Hide” always hides all popups (e.g: in an event).
[*] Tutorial hints are now also displayed in game log.
[*] Added a game log that says when a viewable unlock is failed.
[*] Unit name will always show when you mouse-over it (even with disabled name display).
[*] Effects & flavour description of units have distinct colors now.
[*] Unit details can now also be displayed by a single right-click and vanish after hitting any other button.
[*] Enemy damage around walls no longer counts towards skull display.
[*] Updated Campfire wording from “lose” to “destroy”.
[/list]

[h3]Mechanics:[/h3]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to ban a curse card for 5 wisdom points.
[/list]

[h3]UI:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New windows.
[*] New items frames.
[/list]

[h3]Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added “Volcano” dungeon.
[*] Added “Time Lab” dungeon.
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fast Breathing:
- added "After 1 turn"
- increased stamina gain from 3 to 5

[*] Demonic Sacrifice:
- added "After 1 turn"
- Reduced health cost from 10 to 6.

[*] Mind Awakening:
- added "After 1 turn"
- Increased mana gain from 4 to 6.

[*] Mana Breathing:
- added "After 1 turn"
- reduced stamina cost from 10 to 7
[/list]

[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 4K support.
[*] Added “feedback” form.
[/list]

[h3]Accessibility:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Polish language introduced, translation is not final yet (more languages will come with next patches).
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Walls discovered by Goblin Leader no longer can fail Labyrinth unlock.
[*] Fixed cards scrolling in character selection - that was supposed to happen on hover over given race/class, not on cards hover.
[*] Resolution should no longer affect animations speed.
[*] Game should no longer freeze during loading.
[*] Card animations no longer bug out when discarded at max zoom.
[*] Mimics no longer wander while mimicking a chest.
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 0.26 - small delay, but coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Lots of bugfixes and UX improvements are coming in 0.26, we will also release 2 new dungeons!

We really wanted to release new version this week, but:
- There are some issues with game localization (fow now - polish only, more languages to come!)
- There are still some bugs left to smash.

We just want to make sure that new version release will be an overall improvement for the game!
This is why, before each release, we always deal with all the bugs we know of.

So, the current ETA for version 0.26: 09.06

Sorry for the delay!

Happy adventuring! ^-^

notes.title: Hotfix 0.25a - released!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Some small changes - mainly bugfixes ^-^

We are currently working on game localization, some languages should be supported in the upcoming weeks!

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[h3]UX:[/h3]
1. Small tutorial improvements.
2. Updated some perks descriptions to make them easier to understand.

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
1. Using Polymorph on Sealing Expert and killing the polymorphed unit now correctly unseals the sealed handslot.
2. Card rarities should display correctly from cards bought/dropped.
3. Fixed Boxer unlock.
4. Karma points should no longer be lost upon crash. All cleared dungeons should count correctly towards summed up karma.
5. Time Bender no longer can reveal enemies after death.
6. Sealing Expert ability no longer triggers multiple times when re-revealed.
7. Returning to game saves sealed hand slots properly.
8. Armor regeneration for monsters should display always (when different than 0).
9. Tile-based unit effects update correctly after they are pushed.
9. Troll is no longer unlocked when having 1/1 hp at the start of the game.
10. Mimic no longer can be detected by trying to use a card on a chest.
11. Cards in Grimoire have their tier-based frames now.
12. Peace Cake now seals new handslots too.

notes.title: Version 0.25 - released! Basic tutorial included.
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

[h3]UX:[/h3]
1. Updated Mage's "Body To Spirit" description -> "Stamina cost multiplied by 2, refund 1 mana for each pure mana card used."
2. Updated Assassin's "Sharp Eye" description -> "Every card that deals damage is penetrating."
3. Updated Gnome unlock description -> “Win while having only free cards.”
4. When pushing a unit (e.g: via kick)  into an occupied tile, a hint shows up "Cannot move, tile occupied."
5. Added custom cursor (to enable/disable go to settings->input).
6. When hovering over race/class with too many cards to display them all - cards slide automatically from left to right.
7. Changed wording in the game from "remove a card" to "destroy a card" (some people confused "remove" with "discard").
8. Hovering over a card in Karma Shop now shows that card.
9. Texts on items are now centered.
10."Changed loot/chest bonuses descriptions to “Heal X health”/”Gain X gold”, so they are more intuitive.
11. Hints like "there are no more points of interest on this level" vanishes slower now.
12. Chest window title changed to “Use one:”.
13. Updated attack of opportunity warning: “When you leave this floor, all discovered enemies will attack you once. Do you want to proceed?”
14. Added “The shopkeeper returned your X.” log if the card is not sold.
15. Snow effect temporarily removed (hey, winter season is long gone!).
16. The game shows next 6 dungeon unlocks instead of 3.
17. Added VFX for silenced units.
18. Added VFX for destroyed cards.
19. Unit names no longer display on the monster, but can be enabled (settings->UI).
20. Reworked unit info display (now displays regen/degen too!).
21. New card frames - now each card rarity has it’s own frame, you can find the rarity gem in top-center socket of each card now!
22. Changed Campfire “Leave.” option to “Leave for now.”
23. Tiny Treasure Room event - now it is possible to take the crown, even if there are no monsters on the level.
24. Rephrased the joke description of “Heart of Emptiness” to a more obvious one: “Rumor has it, that only Virgo, the celestial virgin, can never feel empty.”

[h3]UI:[/h3]
1. New user interface for Shop.

[h3]Other:[/h3]
1. Added a simple tutorial (tutorial progress can be reset in options->UI).
2. Added credits.
3. Draconis unlock requirement changed.
4. As some people considered “Curse of Wokeness” offensive, name updated to “Curse of Greed”.

[h3]Content:[/h3]
1. Added two new dungeons:
Undercity of the Dead
Gargoyle Dungeon

[h3]Optimization:[/h3]
1. Character creation scene should no longer cause a huge FPS drop during animations.

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
1. Updated level scaling of units to be less exponential.
2. Changes in content:
[b]Buffs:[/b]
1. Adventurer's "Fishing" perk -> from "1% every turn" to "every 10 turns".
2. Petrification (25%->40%)
3. Masterful Sculpting (10%->25%)
4. Second Wind health cost (50->40).
5. “Scientific Magic” perk -> cost increase for mana cards changed from x2 to +2
6. “Banish” card -> removed “lose all stamina and mana” effect.

[b]Nerfs:[/b]
1. Adventurer's base stats nerfed (compensation for buffed perk):
Health: +5 -> -5
Armor: +0 -> -10
Stamina: +5 -> +0
Strength: +1 -> -1
Magic: +1 -> -1

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
1. Silence no longer disables chest/fragment spawn from elites.
2. Slime no longer reveal tiles around itself upon death.
3. Game saves set resolution correctly now.
4. Game save import sets up the flags of cleared dungeons correctly now.
5. Classes with multi-word name no longer can corrupt save file and thus disable ability to “continue”.
6. Lingering cards save their duration properly now.
7. You no longer can get “minus” gold in shop.
8. Lingering cards duration updates correctly now, whenever skipping a tile by a special action (like campfire).
9. Killing a unit without using a card no longer triggers Mage unlock.
10. Re-entering the arena no longer bugs out units within and units spawn properly.
11. After completing the dungeon, the cleared dungeons flags update properly now.
12. Spamming campfire no longer disables drawing cards altogether.
